fields.title: Seed Preference Poll Now Open � Dry Season 2023
fields.content:
The Municipal Agriculture Office has launched the Dry Season 2023 Seed Preference Poll.

All registered and approved farmers are encouraged to participate by casting their seed variety preference for the upcoming Dry Season 2023 planting season.

Voting Period: Now until December 30, 2023 at 02:13 PM.

Log in to the AGRICE app to submit your seed preference. Your vote helps the MAO plan the seed distribution program for your barangay.

Thank you for your participation.

The Municipal Agriculture Office has finalized the seed varieties for the Dry Season 2023 planting season.

Confirmed Seed Varieties:
� Hybrid: Bigante plus, Pioneer
� Inbred: RC-10, RC-120

Barangay Presidents may now proceed to create their Beneficiary Lists based on these confirmed varieties. Farmers will receive seeds according to their barangay's distribution schedule.

Please coordinate with your Barangay Agricultural Technician for further details.

Thank you.
